changelog:
Initial release of meeting-transcript-to-summary skill.

- Converts pasted meeting transcripts into structured summaries, including decisions, action items, and decision owners.
- Only activates for meeting transcript inputs; declines off-topic or non-transcript requests.
- Validates input format and provides clear error or guidance messages when needed.
- Structured output includes: summary, decisions, action items (with assignees and deadlines), and open items.
- Handles ambiguous or incomplete input by stating assumptions and asking clarifying questions.
summary: Use when (1) user pastes meeting transcript and needs structured summary with action items and decision owners.
